exercises.instructionEn: Sandra and David are in an aeroplane to Brazil. They want to write an article about the destruction of the Amazon rainforest.
exercises.instructionUz: Sandra va Devid Braziliyaga ketayotgan samolyotda. Ular Amazon tropik o'rmonining yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola yozmoqchi.
exercises.explanationUz:
YANGI HIKOYA BOSHLANDI: 'THE EXPEDITION' (Ekspeditsiya)

Bu — kitobdagi IKKINCHI hikoya turkumi.
Birinchisi 'The Loch Ness Monster' edi (2 va 6-unitlardan keyin).

QAHRAMONLAR:
  SANDRA — sariq sochli jurnalist ayol
  DAVID  — qizil kepkali jurnalist erkak

JOY: Braziliya, Amazon tropik o'rmoni

MAQSAD: Amazon o'rmonining yo'q qilinishi haqida
        maqola yozish

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an expedition   = ekspeditsiya, ilmiy safar
  a waterfall     = sharshara
  destruction     = yo'q qilinish, vayron qilish
  a rainforest    = tropik yomg'ir o'rmoni
  the Amazon      = Amazonka (daryo va o'rmon)
  Brazil          = Braziliya
  the Jivaro Indians = Xivaro hindulari (Amazon qabilasi)

DIQQAT — 'THE' QO'YILISHI:
  the Amazon River      (daryo nomi → THE)
  the Amazon rainforest (aniq joy → THE)
  the Jivaro Indians    (qabila nomi → THE)
  Brazil                (mamlakat nomi → THE YO'Q)
  David, Sandra         (ism → THE YO'Q)
Bu qoida 69-betda batafsil tushuntiriladi.

tasks.en: Sandra and David are in an aeroplane to Brazil. They want to write an article about the destruction of the Amazon rainforest.
tasks.uz: Sandra va Devid Braziliyaga ketayotgan samolyotda. Ular Amazon tropik o'rmonining yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola yozmoqchi.

tasks.en: Sandra and David are in an aeroplane to Brazil.
tasks.uz: Sandra va Devid Braziliyaga ketayotgan samolyotda.
tasks.note:
'an aeroplane' — 'a' unli tovush oldidan 'an'.
Amerikacha: airplane.

tasks.en: They want to write an article about the destruction of the Amazon rainforest.
tasks.uz: Ular Amazon tropik o'rmonining yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola yozmoqchi.
tasks.note:
'want TO write' — 'want' dan keyin 'to' + fe'l.
'destruction' = yo'q qilinish (to destroy fe'lidan).
'a rainforest' = tropik yomg'ir o'rmoni.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ HIKOYA (9 ta rasm):

1) ON THE PLANE ... (Samolyotda)
   SANDRA: David, do you think the Jivaro Indians are
           dangerous?
   DAVID:  I don't know. I hope not!

2) AT THE HOTEL ... (Mehmonxonada)
   SANDRA: David, they called us from the reception desk.
           Our jeep is ready.
   DAVID:  Let's go, then. Don't forget to take your hat.
           It's boiling hot out there.

3) IN THE JUNGLE ... (O'rmonda)
   SANDRA: I don't like the jungle. It makes me nervous.
           I feel like someone is watching us all the time.
   DAVID:  Don't be silly. It's so nice and peaceful here.

4) SANDRA: Sh!!! Listen! Can you hear the drums?

5) DAVID:  Oh no! It's the Jivaro Indians and they don't
           look friendly. Sandra, run! Let's go to the river.

6) DAVID:  Look ... a canoe! Quick! Let's get in it.

7) SANDRA: Come on! Paddle faster!
   DAVID:  Calm down. They can't catch us now.

8) DAVID:  Sandra, watch your head!
   SANDRA: Oh, no! A waterfall!

9) IKKALASI: Help! Help! Help!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

1) SAMOLYOTDA
   SANDRA: Devid, sencha Xivaro hindulari xavflimi?
   DEVID:  Bilmayman. Umid qilamanki, yo'q!

2) MEHMONXONADA
   SANDRA: Devid, qabulxonadan qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.
           Jipimiz tayyor.
   DEVID:  Unda ketdik. Shlyapangni olishni unutma.
           U yerda jazirama issiq.

3) O'RMONDA
   SANDRA: Menga o'rmon yoqmaydi. U meni asabiylashtiradi.
           Kimdir bizni doim kuzatayotgandek tuyuladi.
   DEVID:  Bema'nilik qilma. Bu yerda juda yoqimli va tinch.

4) SANDRA: Shsh! Quloq sol! Nog'ora ovozini eshityapsanmi?

5) DEVID:  Voy! Bu Xivaro hindulari va ular do'stona
           ko'rinmayapti. Sandra, yugur! Daryoga boraylik.

6) DEVID:  Qara ... qayiq! Tez! Ichiga tushaylik.

7) SANDRA: Qani! Tezroq eshkak esh!
   DEVID:  Tinchlan. Endi bizni tuta olishmaydi.

8) DEVID:  Sandra, boshingni ehtiyot qil!
   SANDRA: Voy, yo'q! Sharshara!

9) IKKALASI: Yordam bering! Yordam bering! Yordam bering!


HIKOYA TUZILISHI (4 joy):
  samolyot → mehmonxona → o'rmon → daryo/sharshara
  Har bir sahnada xavf ortib boradi.

tasks.en: Read the episode.
David, do you think the Jivaro Indians are dangerous?
tasks.note:
SANDRA (samolyotda).
'Do you think ...?' = sencha ...?
'the Jivaro Indians' — qabila nomi oldidan THE.

tasks.en: I don't know. I hope not!
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'I hope not' = umid qilamanki, unday emas.
Aksi: 'I hope so' = umid qilamanki, shunday.

tasks.en: David, they called us from the reception desk. Our jeep is ready.
tasks.uz: Devid, qabulxonadan qo'ng'iroq qilishdi. Jipimiz tayyor.
tasks.note:
SANDRA (mehmonxonada).
'the reception desk' = mehmonxona qabulxonasi.
'ready' = tayyor.

tasks.en: Let's go, then. Don't forget to take your hat. It's boiling hot out there.
tasks.uz: Unda ketdik. Shlyapangni olishni unutma. U yerda jazirama issiq.
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'Let's go' = ketdik ('let us' ning qisqasi).
'Don't forget TO take' — 'forget' dan keyin 'to' + fe'l.
'boiling hot' = jazirama issiq (so'zma-so'z: qaynayotgan issiq).
'out there' = u yerda, tashqarida.

tasks.en: I don't like the jungle. It makes me nervous.
tasks.uz: Menga o'rmon yoqmaydi. U meni asabiylashtiradi.
tasks.note:
SANDRA (o'rmonda).
'the jungle' = tropik o'rmon.
'It makes me nervous' = u meni asabiylashtiradi.
'make somebody + sifat' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.en: I feel like someone is watching us all the time.
tasks.note:
SANDRA.
'I feel like ...' = ...dek tuyuladi.
'all the time' = doim, har doim.
'is watching' — present continuous (ayni damda).

tasks.en: Don't be silly. It's so nice and peaceful here.
tasks.uz: Bema'nilik qilma. Bu yerda juda yoqimli va tinch.
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'Don't be silly' = bema'nilik qilma, ahmoqona gapirma.
'silly' = bema'ni, ahmoqona.
'peaceful' = tinch, osoyishta.

tasks.en: Sh!!! Listen! Can you hear the drums?
tasks.uz: Shsh! Quloq sol! Nog'ora ovozini eshityapsanmi?
tasks.note:
SANDRA.
'Sh!' = jim! (tovush belgisi).
DIQQAT: 'listen' — quloq solmoq (harakat);
'hear' — eshitmoq (natija).
'a drum' = nog'ora, baraban.

tasks.en: Oh no! It's the Jivaro Indians and they don't look friendly.
tasks.uz: Voy! Bu Xivaro hindulari va ular do'stona ko'rinmayapti.
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'they don't LOOK friendly' = do'stona KO'RINMAYAPTI.
'look + sifat' = ...ko'rinmoq.

tasks.en: Sandra, run! Let's go to the river.
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'run!' — buyruq gap.
'Let's go to ...' = ...ga boraylik.

tasks.en: Look ... a canoe! Quick! Let's get in it.
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'a canoe' = qayiq (birinchi marta aytilyapti → A).
'get in' = ichiga tushmoq, o'tirmoq.

tasks.en: Come on! Paddle faster!
tasks.note:
SANDRA.
'Come on!' = qani!, tezroq! (undov).
'to paddle' = eshkak eshmoq.
'faster' = tezroq (fast ning qiyosiy darajasi).

tasks.en: Calm down. They can't catch us now.
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'Calm down' = tinchlan, xotirjam bo'l.
'to catch' = tutmoq, ushlamoq.

tasks.en: Sandra, watch your head!
tasks.note:
DAVID.
'Watch your head!' = boshingni ehtiyot qil!
'watch' bu yerda = ehtiyot bo'lmoq (ko'rmoq emas).
Shunga o'xshash: 'Watch out!' = ehtiyot bo'l!

tasks.en: Oh, no! A waterfall!
tasks.note:
SANDRA.
'a waterfall' = sharshara (birinchi marta → A).
Epizod nomi shu so'zdan olingan.

tasks.en: Help! Help! Help!
tasks.note:
IKKALASI — sharsharadan qulayotganda.
Epizod shu yerda tugaydi (davomi keyingi epizodda).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 68. Which picture(s) show(s):
exercises.explanationUz:
68-BETDAGI 9 RASM:
  1  Samolyotda — Sandra va Devid o'rindiqda
  2  Mehmonxonada — Devid o'tirgan, jip haqida gap
  3  O'rmonda — jip yonida, Sandra asabiy
  4  O'rmonda — nog'ora ovozi, orqada hindular
  5  O'rmonda — qochish, 'Sandra, run!'
  6  Daryo bo'yida — qayiqni ko'rishdi
  7  Qayiqda — eshkak eshish
  8  Qayiqda — sharshara ko'rindi
  9  Sharsharadan qulash — 'Help!'

Ba'zi savollarga BIR NECHA rasm javob bo'ladi —
savolda 'picture(S)' deb ko'plik qavs ichida berilgan.

tasks.whyUz:
3-rasmda oq jip ko'rinadi (o'rmonga yetib kelishgan).
2-rasmda jip haqida GAPIRILADI, lekin ko'rinmaydi.

8-rasmda sharsharani KO'RISHADI ('Oh, no! A waterfall!'),
9-rasmda esa undan QULASHADI ('Help!').

6-rasmda qayiqni topishadi,
7 va 8-rasmda qayiqda suzishadi,
9-rasmda qayiq bilan qulashadi.

tasks.prompt: d  David and Sandra falling down the waterfall?
tasks.whyUz:
9-rasm — 'Help! Help! Help!' deb qulayotgan sahna.
'to fall down' = qulamoq, tushib ketmoq.
tasks.speak: d  David and Sandra falling down the waterfall?

tasks.prompt: e  David and Sandra on the plane?
tasks.whyUz:
1-rasm — 'ON THE PLANE ...' sarlavhasi bilan.
Deraza va o'rindiqlar ko'rinadi.
tasks.speak: e  David and Sandra on the plane?

tasks.prompt: f  David and Sandra in a hotel room?
tasks.whyUz:
2-rasm — 'AT THE HOTEL ...' sarlavhasi bilan.
DIQQAT: bu rasmda faqat Devid ko'rinadi,
Sandra kadr tashqarisidan gapiradi.
tasks.speak: f  David and Sandra in a hotel room?

exercises.instructionEn: Who said the following? Listen to the story and write S (for Sandra) and D (for David).
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni kim aytdi? Hikoyani tinglang va S (Sandra) yoki D (Devid) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
USUL — GAPGA QARAB ANIQLASH:

  Agar gapda ISM chaqirilsa, uni BOSHQASI aytadi:
     'David, ...' → SANDRA aytdi
     'Sandra, ...' → DEVID aytdi

  Xarakterlar farqi ham yordam beradi:
     SANDRA — qo'rqoq, asabiy, xavotirli
     DEVID  — xotirjam, tinchlantiruvchi

Javoblarni 68-betdagi matndan ham tekshirsa bo'ladi.

tasks.whyUz:
DEVID (2-rasm).
To'liq gap: 'Let's go, then. Don't forget to take your hat.
It's boiling hot out there.'

SANDRA (3-rasm).
To'liq gap: 'I don't like the jungle. It makes me nervous.'
Devid esa aksincha — o'rmon unga yoqadi.

SANDRA (3-rasm).
To'liq gap: 'I feel like someone is watching us all the time.'
Bu — Sandraning xavotiri.

DEVID (5-rasm).
To'liq gap: 'Sandra, run! Let's go to the river.'
DIQQAT: gapda 'Sandra' chaqirilgan → demak DEVID aytdi.

DEVID (7-rasm).
To'liq gap: 'Calm down. They can't catch us now.'
Devid — doim tinchlantiruvchi tomon.

SANDRA (8-rasm).
Devid 'Sandra, watch your head!' degandan keyin
Sandra sharsharani ko'rib qichqiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir savolning javobi 68-betdagi matnda BOR.
To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

tasks.prompt: 1  What's the weather like in the jungle?
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'It's boiling hot out there.'
DIQQAT — savol qolipi: 'What's the weather LIKE?'
= Ob-havo qanday?  ('like' javobda takrorlanmaydi).
tasks.speak: 1  What's the weather like in the jungle?

tasks.prompt: 2  Why is Sandra nervous in picture 3?
tasks.answer: Because she feels like someone is watching them all the time.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'I feel like someone is watching us all the time.'
Javobda 'us' → 'them' ga o'zgaradi
(Sandra o'zi haqida gapirgan, biz u haqida gapiryapmiz).
'Why ...?' savoliga 'Because ...' bilan javob beriladi.
tasks.speak: 2  Why is Sandra nervous in picture 3?

tasks.prompt: 3  Does David like the jungle? Why/Why not?
tasks.answer: Yes, he does. He thinks it's nice and peaceful.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Don't be silly. It's so nice and peaceful here.'
Sandraga QARAMA-QARSHI fikrda.
Qisqa javob: 'Yes, he does' ('Does ...?' savoliga).
tasks.speak: 3  Does David like the jungle? Why/Why not?

tasks.prompt: 4  Who hears the Jivaro Indians first?
tasks.answer: Sandra does. She hears the drums.
tasks.whyUz:
4-rasmda SANDRA: 'Sh!!! Listen! Can you hear the drums?'
Devid esa faqat 5-rasmda ko'radi.
'first' = birinchi bo'lib.
Qisqa javob: 'Sandra does.'
tasks.speak: 4  Who hears the Jivaro Indians first?

tasks.answer: Be careful — there is something above you and you may hit your head.
tasks.whyUz:
'Watch your head!' = boshingni ehtiyot qil!
'watch' bu yerda KO'RMOQ emas, EHTIYOT BO'LMOQ.
Shunga o'xshash: 'Watch out!' = ehtiyot bo'l!
'Watch your step!' = qadamingni ehtiyot qil!

'Come on!' = qani!, tezroq!, davom et!
Bu — shoshiltiruvchi yoki dalda beruvchi undov.
So'zma-so'z tarjima qilinmaydi.

'Calm down' = tinchlan, xotirjam bo'l, hovuridan tush.
'calm' = tinch, xotirjam (4-mashqda 'nervous' ning aksi).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the adjectives to their opposites.
exercises.explanationUz:
CHAP USTUN:  silly, nervous, dangerous, nice, peaceful,
             boiling hot
O'NG USTUN:  safe, freezing cold, noisy, calm, clever,
             horrible

Kitobda BIR juftlik allaqachon chizilgan:
  silly → clever

Hamma sifat 68-betdagi hikoyada uchraydi.

DIQQAT — 'BOILING HOT' va 'FREEZING COLD':
  Bular KUCHAYTIRILGAN sifatlar:
     boiling hot   = qaynayotgandek issiq (juda issiq)
     freezing cold = muzlaydigan darajada sovuq
  'to boil' = qaynamoq;  'to freeze' = muzlamoq

exercises.instructionEn: Then, use the adjectives in the left column to make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng chap ustundagi sifatlar bilan namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Don't be silly.

Gaplarni hikoyadan olsangiz eng yaxshi bo'ladi —
hammasi 68-betda bor.

SIFAT GAPDA QAYERDA TURADI:
  'to be' dan KEYIN:  It is nice.  /  Don't be silly.
  OTDAN OLDIN:        a dangerous animal, a peaceful place

tasks.whyUz:
Devidning 68-betdagi gapi.
Buyruq gap: 'Don't be' + sifat.

Hikoyadan: 'It makes me nervous.'
'make somebody + sifat' — 'to' kerak emas.

tasks.answer: Do you think the Jivaro Indians are dangerous?
tasks.whyUz:
Hikoyadan olingan.
'to be' dan keyin sifat turadi.

tasks.answer: It's so nice and peaceful here.
tasks.whyUz:
Hikoyadan olingan.
'so' — sifatni kuchaytiradi.

'peaceful' — joy haqida ishlatiladi.
'very' — kuchaytirgich.

Hikoyadan olingan.
Ob-havo haqida gapirganda ega — 'it'.

exercises.explanationUz:
ASOSIY QOIDA:

  A/AN — biror narsa haqida BIRINCHI MARTA gapirganda
  THE  — ILGARI AYTILGAN narsa haqida gapirganda

  MISOL:
     There's A jeep outside.       (birinchi marta)
     THE jeep belongs to Mr Jones. (o'sha jip haqida)

  Hikoyadan misol:
     Look ... A canoe!             (birinchi marta)
     David starts paddling ... in THE canoe.  (o'sha qayiq)

THE QO'YILADI:

  • daryo nomlari      → the Amazon River
  • dengiz nomlari     → the Black Sea
  • okean nomlari      → the Atlantic
  • tog' tizmalari     → the Alps
  • millat nomlari     → the English
  • oila nomlari       → the Browns
  • qabila nomlari     → the Jivaro Indians

THE QO'YILMAYDI:

  • atoqli otlar       → Jane, Athens
  • mamlakat nomlari   → Britain, Brazil
  • ovqat nomlari      → breakfast, lunch, dinner
  • sport/o'yin nomlari → tennis, football

A yoki AN — QAY BIRI?
  UNDOSH tovush oldidan → A   (a jeep, a canoe)
  UNLI tovush oldidan   → AN  (an article, an aeroplane)
  DIQQAT: yozilishiga emas, TOVUSHGA qaraladi.

ESLATMA — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDA ISTISNO:
  Ko'plik yoki 'union/kingdom/republic' so'zi bo'lsa THE:
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Philippines
  Oddiy mamlakat nomlarida THE yo'q:
     Brazil, Britain, Uzbekistan

tasks.en: a/an - the
We use a/an to talk about something for the first time.
tasks.uz: A/AN ni biror narsa haqida birinchi marta gapirganda ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
Misol: There's A jeep outside.

tasks.en: We use the to talk about something we have mentioned before.
tasks.uz: THE ni ilgari aytilgan narsa haqida gapirganda ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
Misol: THE jeep belongs to Mr Jones.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary and fill in a, an or the, where necessary.
exercises.instructionUz: Xulosani o'qing va kerak bo'lgan joyga a, an yoki the ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ XULOSA (to'ldirilgan holda):

  David and Sandra go to Brazil to write AN article about
  THE Amazon rainforest. In the jungle, Sandra feels
  nervous. Suddenly, she hears THE Jivaro Indians. They run
  to THE Amazon River and get in A canoe. David starts
  paddling down THE river in THE canoe. Suddenly, they see
  A waterfall.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Devid va Sandra Amazon tropik o'rmoni haqida maqola
  yozish uchun Braziliyaga boradilar. O'rmonda Sandra
  asabiylashadi. To'satdan u Xivaro hindularini eshitadi.
  Ular Amazon daryosiga yugurib borib qayiqqa tushadilar.
  Devid qayiqda daryo bo'ylab eshkak esha boshlaydi.
  To'satdan ular sharsharani ko'radilar.

DIQQAT — 'WHERE NECESSARY':
  Ba'zi bo'shliqlarga HECH NARSA qo'yilmaydi (—).
  Bular: David, Sandra, Brazil (atoqli ot va mamlakat).

ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — A → THE:
  get in A canoe        (birinchi marta)
  in THE canoe          (o'sha qayiq)
  Xuddi shunday:
  run to THE Amazon River  (daryo nomi → the)
  paddling down THE river  (o'sha daryo → the)

tasks.whyUz: 'David' — ATOQLI OT → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
'Sandra' — ATOQLI OT → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

'Brazil' — MAMLAKAT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
ISTISNO: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands.

Maqola BIRINCHI marta aytilyapti → A/AN.
'article' /ˈɑːtɪkl/ — UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN.

'the Amazon rainforest' — ANIQ, yagona joy → THE.
Amazon daryosi bilan bir xil qoida.

tasks.prompt: 6  In the jungle, ............ Sandra feels nervous.
tasks.whyUz:
'Sandra' — ATOQLI OT → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
DIQQAT: 'the jungle' da esa THE bor (matnda berilgan).
tasks.speak: 6  In the jungle, ............ Sandra feels nervous.

tasks.whyUz:
'the Jivaro Indians' — QABILA nomi → THE SHART.
Qoidada aynan shu misol berilgan.

'the Amazon River' — DARYO nomi → THE SHART.
Qoidada aynan shu misol berilgan.

Qayiq BIRINCHI marta aytilyapti → A.
'canoe' /kəˈnuː/ — 'k' undosh tovush → A ('an' EMAS).
68-betda ham shunday: 'Look ... A canoe!'

8-bandda 'the Amazon River' aytilgan → endi THE river.
ILGARI AYTILGAN narsa → THE.

9-bandda 'A canoe' aytilgan → endi THE canoe.
Bu — A → THE o'zgarishining eng aniq misoli.

Sharshara BIRINCHI marta aytilyapti → A.
'waterfall' — 'w' undosh tovush → A.
68-betda ham: 'Oh, no! A waterfall!'

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the episode and follow the dialogue. Then, take roles and read it aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni tinglang va dialogni kuzatib boring. So'ng rollarga bo'linib ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
WILL — KELASI ZAMON

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  WILL go.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  WON'T (will not) go.
  SO'ROQ       WILL I/you/he, etc  go?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc WILL.
               No,  I/you/he, etc WON'T.

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'will' ni BASHORAT qilish uchun ishlatamiz.
     I think the Jivaro Indians WILL catch them.
     Perhaps Sandra WILL hit her head.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — WILL.
     I will, he will, they will — -S YO'Q.
     'he wills' XATO.

  2) KEYINGI FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA, 'to' SIZ:
        He will go.        ✓
        He will to go.     ✗ XATO
        He will goes.      ✗ XATO
        He will went.      ✗ XATO

  3) 'DO/DOES/DID' KERAK EMAS:
        Will he go?        ✓
        Does he will go?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMA:
  will not → WON'T  (/wəʊnt/)
  DIQQAT: 'willn't' shakli YO'Q.
  Og'zaki nutqda: I'll, you'll, he'll, we'll, they'll

BASHORAT SO'ZLARI ('will' bilan birga keladi):
  I think ...    = menimcha ...
  I hope ...     = umid qilaman ...
  Perhaps ...    = ehtimol ...
  Maybe ...      = balki ...
  I'm sure ...   = ishonchim komil ...

tasks.uz: Epizodni tinglang va dialogni kuzatib boring. So'ng rollarga bo'linib ovoz chiqarib o'qing.

tasks.en: I/you/he, etc will go.
tasks.note:
TASDIQ. 'will' hamma ega uchun bir xil.
Keyingi fe'l asosiy shaklda, 'to' siz.

tasks.en: I/you/he, etc won't (will not) go.
tasks.note:
INKOR: will + not = WON'T.
'willn't' shakli YO'Q.

tasks.en: Will I/you/he, etc go?
tasks.note:
SO'ROQ: WILL gap boshiga chiqadi.
'do/does' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.en: Yes, I/you/he, etc will. — No, I/you/he, etc won't.
tasks.note:
Qisqa javobda 'will/won't' takrorlanadi,
asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

tasks.en: We use will to make predictions.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
Bashorat = kelajakda nima bo'lishi haqidagi fikr.

tasks.en: I think the Jivaro Indians will catch them.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-MISOL.
'I think' — bashorat so'zi.

tasks.en: Perhaps Sandra will hit her head.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-MISOL.
'Perhaps' = ehtimol.
'to hit' = urmoq, urilmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the objects to the words in the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: boiling hot, rainy, freezing cold, snowy

OLTI BUYUM:
  umbrella (soyabon), hat (shlyapa),
  swimming-costume (cho'milish kiyimi), sunglasses (ko'zoynak),
  jacket (kurtka), gloves (qo'lqop)

To'rt ob-havo so'zi, olti buyum — demak ba'zi ob-havoga
BIR NECHA buyum to'g'ri keladi.

DIQQAT — 'SUNGLASSES' va 'GLOVES' KO'PLIKDA:
  sunglasses — DOIM ko'plikda (ikkita shisha)
  gloves     — juft (bitta bo'lsa 'a glove')
  Shunga o'xshash: trousers, jeans, scissors

exercises.instructionEn: Then make predictions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  It will be boiling hot tomorrow, so don't forget to take
  your hat.

QOLIP:
  It WILL BE [ob-havo] tomorrow, SO don't forget to take
  your [buyum].

UCH DIQQAT:

  1) 'It will BE' — 'will' dan keyin 'be' asosiy shaklda
     ('It will is' XATO).

  2) 'SO' — natijani bog'laydi (shuning uchun).
     Oldidan VERGUL qo'yiladi.

  3) 'take YOUR hat' — egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi
     ('take the hat' emas).

tasks.answer: It will be boiling hot tomorrow, so don't forget to take your hat.
tasks.whyUz:
Qolip: It will be + ob-havo + tomorrow, so don't forget
to take your + buyum.

tasks.answer: It will be rainy tomorrow, so don't forget to take your umbrella.
tasks.whyUz:
'rainy' = yomg'irli.
Soyabon yomg'irdan himoya qiladi.

tasks.answer: It will be boiling hot tomorrow, so don't forget to take your sunglasses.
tasks.whyUz: 'sunglasses' ko'plikda — 'your sunglasses'.

tasks.answer: It will be boiling hot tomorrow, so don't forget to take your swimming-costume.
tasks.whyUz: Issiq kunda suvga tushiladi.

tasks.answer: It will be freezing cold tomorrow, so don't forget to take your gloves.
tasks.whyUz:
'freezing cold' = qahraton sovuq.
'gloves' ko'plikda.

tasks.answer: It will be snowy tomorrow, so don't forget to take your jacket.
tasks.whyUz:
'snowy' = qorli.
Kurtka 'freezing cold' bilan ham to'g'ri keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you think will/won't happen to David and Sandra? Use the prompts below to make one positive and one negative prediction.
exercises.instructionUz: Sizningcha Devid va Sandraga nima bo'ladi / bo'lmaydi? Quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib bitta ijobiy va bitta salbiy bashorat qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMALAR:
  they/die
  they/break their legs
  a crocodile/eat them
  they/drown
  they/hurt themselves
  David/save Sandra
  the Jivaro Indians catch/kill them
  the Jivaro Indians/help them

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  The Jivaro Indians will catch and kill them.
  They won't help them.

QOLIP:
  IJOBIY:  [ega] WILL [fe'l].
  SALBIY:  [ega] WON'T [fe'l].

Kitob BITTA ijobiy va BITTA salbiy bashorat so'raydi,
lekin quyida barcha ko'rsatmalar bo'yicha namunalar
berilgan — mashq qilish uchun.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to die           = o'lmoq
  to break         = sindirmoq
  a crocodile      = timsoh
  to drown         = cho'kib ketmoq
  to hurt oneself  = jarohat olmoq
  to save          = qutqarmoq
  to kill          = o'ldirmoq

DIQQAT — 'THEMSELVES':
  'hurt THEMSELVES' = o'zlarini jarohatlashmoq.
  Harakat egaga qaytsa, o'zlik olmoshi ishlatiladi:
     myself, yourself, himself, herself,
     ourselves, yourselves, themselves

tasks.answer: The Jivaro Indians will catch and kill them.
tasks.whyUz:
Ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan —
'will' faqat BIR MARTA yoziladi:
'will catch and kill' ('will catch and will kill' shart emas).

'won't' = will not.
Ega takrorlanmasligi uchun 'They' ishlatilgan.

tasks.answer: They will die. / They won't die.
tasks.whyUz:
'to die' = o'lmoq.
Ikkala variant ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri —
bashorat sizning fikringiz.

tasks.answer: They will break their legs. / They won't break their legs.
tasks.whyUz:
'to break' = sindirmoq.
'their legs' — egalik olmoshi ('the legs' emas).

tasks.answer: A crocodile will eat them. / A crocodile won't eat them.
tasks.whyUz:
'a crocodile' — birinchi marta aytilyapti → A.
Amazon daryosida timsohlar bor.

tasks.answer: They will drown. / They won't drown.
tasks.whyUz:
'to drown' = cho'kib ketmoq (suvda halok bo'lmoq).
Sharsharadan qulaganda eng ehtimolli xavf.

tasks.answer: They will hurt themselves. / They won't hurt themselves.
tasks.whyUz:
'to hurt oneself' = o'zini jarohatlamoq.
'themselves' — o'zlik olmoshi (harakat egaga qaytadi).

tasks.answer: David will save Sandra. / David won't save Sandra.
tasks.whyUz:
'to save' = qutqarmoq.
Hikoyada Devid doim tinchlantiruvchi va tadbirkor tomon —
shuning uchun bu bashorat ehtimolli.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ega YO'Q, fe'l asosiy shaklda. Inkorda 'Don't'.

wordFormation.ruleUz: LOOK, WATCH, SEE, HEAR, LISTEN — farqi
A / AN / THE / — : qachon qaysi biri

wordFormation.explanationUz: Modal fe'l — hamma shaxsda bir xil.

items.derived: Perhaps Sandra will hit her head.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikki so'z birga — kuchli ma'no beradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: David, do you think the Jivaro Indians are dangerous?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Fikr so'rash qolipi.
'Do you think' dan keyin ODDIY gap tartibi keladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I feel like someone is watching us all the time.
Don't be silly. Let's go to the river.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Buyruq gaplarda EGA yo'q.
'Let's' = 'Let us' — taklif bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't forget to take your hat.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WILL + asosiy fe'l.   /   Ega + WON'T + asosiy fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Jivaro Indians will catch them. They won't help them.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xivaro hindulari ularni tutadi. Ular yordam bermaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil — -s yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: It WILL BE + ob-havo + tomorrow, SO don't forget to take your + buyum.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be boiling hot tomorrow, so don't forget to take your hat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga jazirama issiq bo'ladi, shuning uchun shlyapangni olishni unutma.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will BE' — 'be' asosiy shaklda.
'so' natijani bog'laydi, oldidan vergul.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think / Perhaps + ega + WILL + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think the Jivaro Indians will catch them. Perhaps Sandra will hit her head.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha Xivaro hindulari ularni tutadi. Ehtimol Sandra boshini urib oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A + ot (birinchi marta) ... THE + o'sha ot (keyingi safar).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They get in a canoe. David starts paddling in the canoe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular qayiqqa tushadilar. Devid qayiqda eshkak esha boshlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Artikl qoidasining eng muhim qismi: A → THE.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the weather LIKE?  →  It's boiling hot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the weather like in the jungle? — It's boiling hot.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI.
Ob-havo haqida ega — DOIM 'it'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why is Sandra nervous? — Because she feels like someone is watching them.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sandra nega asabiy? — Chunki kimdir ularni kuzatayotgandek tuyuladi.
